sources.revision: Open issue index reviewed 2026-10-19; mutable source links are not immutable runtime evidence
sources.observed: The current open-issue index includes reports titled around R2007+ LTYPE dash text (#1450), FIELD with zero child values (#1451), misaligned BITCODE_RS in EED encoding (#1452), JSON LWPOLYLINE-width import (#1439), R2007+ material/plotstyle flag interpretation (#1436), and Windows timestamp fail-fast (#1419). The current issue index supplies discovery/status, not a reproduction or local defect. Earlier detailed evidence and owner crosswalks are retained in the plan.

The formal release page lists v3.7.1 as latest. PRs #1150, #1174, and #1240 display as open; #1240 has no deployment and depends on #1174. A #1150 comment says '#1174 is in', while the live #1174 PR page still displays Open. This status conflict is resolved conservatively: do not treat the comment as proof of merge/release; pin source commits and inspect the actual tested tree. Contributor-reported native-reader checks on an open branch remain self-reported and do not establish B-rep semantics.

Remains the controlling byte-layout reference. The material/plotstyle disagreement raised by LibreDWG #1436 remains an open spec/producer-trace reconciliation question; a peer issue title or mutable peer source is not normative authority.

assessment.planImpact: Refreshes peer issue/release status, confirms that the recent LibreDWG titles map to existing local owners or an unsupported JSON route, preserves the unresolved ODA-led #1436 reconciliation, and separates ACadSharp v3.7.1 from open PR branches. method.kind: Read-only primary-source web review plus local plan crosswalk
method.limitations: Recent LibreDWG issue pages were not all fetchable in this research pass; the refreshed issue index establishes their current listing/title only. Detailed issue semantics are cited from prior source reviews already recorded in the plan. Mutable issue, release, and PR pages do not qualify a built artifact or runtime behavior.

implementationReadyChecks: Reuse existing exact local controls for LTYPE text flags, zero-child FIELD ownership, and EED/XDATA boundaries when those owners change; do not duplicate them from peer titles.

Keep ACadSharp release v3.7.1 separate from open PR heads #1150/#1174/#1240; pin exact commits and dependencies before any optional comparison.
Keep ACIS carrier preservation, section/entity association, independent parse, native open/regeneration, and analytic solid validity as distinct outcomes.
Do not add peer installations, fuzzing, native CAD runs, or full suites to ordinary fast slices.
